description: CSS styles for theme management and layout of a Tic Tac Toe frontend application, including light and dark themes, styling for the main app components, and responsive design features.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class responsible for the central styling and layout of the Tic Tac Toe frontend.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header class for the application, sets background, alignment, and styling for content.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styling for links within the application, providing color transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button class for toggling between light and dark themes, with hover and active effects.
